name: Jest of Toxic Tendrils
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: one, two, or three creatures within a 10-foot radius of an ally.
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Target creatures gain a -2 penalty to hit the ally designated. If you have ranks in Bluff, that ally receives a +2 circumstance bonus on their attack roll to hit the designated targets.
